messages:
Lina CSM: Heads up — MeridianPay (MDN-4412) flagged by health monitor: 60% drop in daily active integrations week-over-week and NPS survey shows friction on setup. Renewal in 32 days. Suggest a small tether + enablement package: 3-week micro-onboard (2x 30m sessions), milestone credit, and a docs walkthrough. Thoughts?

Omar (RevOps): Agree. We can approve a $1k milestone credit for midmarket until it becomes enterprise. Need exact renewal date and specific success metric to gate credit.

Lina CSM: Renewal date 2026-05-25. Proposed gate: 20% increase in weekly active integrations or reactivation of top 3 merchants by end of 21 days. Credit $1k conditional.

Priya (Enablement): I can run the 30m sessions. Recommend session A: integration checklist + common gotchas (webhooks, retry logic). Session B: growth tactics + routing best practices. I'll prepare a one-pager and a short enablement checklist for product owners.

Jared Eng: From infra side I can look for any model fallback or quota throttles. Quick ask: can you export the last 48h request logs and any recent webhook failures? If we see 401/timeout patterns that's usually the cause.

Lina CSM: Uploaded logs to CS-4922. Quick excerpt: spike of 429s on 2026-03-21 02:14 UTC coming from a single client IP, then many retries. Also a note in their support ticket that they rolled a new integration in the last push.

Priya (Enablement): Suggest we run a session first, then a joint technical call if needed. I can lead the first enablement call Wed 11am PT.

Omar (RevOps): Approved credit: $1,000 one-time, expires 30 days after issuance. I'll attach to CS-4922 and tag finance to hold until the gate is verified.

cs-bot: Created ticket CS-4922. Labels: micro-onboard, renewal-risk, credit-pending. SLA=72h.

Lina CSM: Outreach draft (short): "Hi — we noticed a drop in integrations. We'd love to run two short sessions to unblock your team and offer a $1k credit if integrations pick up by the end of the 3-week program. Can we book Wed 11am PT?" Sending now.

Jared Eng: Pre-call checklist I'll run: 1) check rate-limit headers and client backoff patterns, 2) validate webhook endpoint stability and retries, 3) confirm model selection hasn't shifted to a higher-latency variant. Share call notes post-session and I'll propose immediate mitigation steps.

Priya (Enablement): One-pager uploaded to ticket with checklist and suggested slide deck. Keeping it lightweight.

Lina CSM: Customer accepted Wed 11am. Invite sent. After session we'll run a 7-day follow-up and post usage snapshot here. If they don't hit the gate, we'll offer an alternate downgrade-safeguard: temporary reduced unit pricing for 30 days to buy time.

Omar (RevOps): Noted. I'll monitor CS-4922 and mark credit pending release upon verification.

Lina CSM: Thanks team — moving to execution. Will update this thread after the enablement sessions and at the 7-day check-in (thread: 1801235000).
